description:
This process begins with monitoring inventory levels in a warehouse or store.
When stock reaches a predefined threshold, an automated alert or manual check signals the need to reorder.
The procurement team then places an order with suppliers, considering factors like cost, delivery time, and supplier reliability.
Once the order is placed, the inventory system updates with expected delivery dates.
Upon receiving the stock, it is inspected for quality, recorded in the system, and placed on shelves or in storage.
The process ends when the inventory levels are updated after the restock is complete.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_Reorder" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/reorder">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Reorder" name="Inventory Reorder Process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Begin" name="Monitoring starts">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Monitor</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MonitorStock" name="Monitor inventory levels">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_Monitor</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ThresholdNo_Monitor</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Monitor_Threshold</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Threshold_Split" name="Threshold reached?" default="Flow_ThresholdNo_Monitor">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Monitor_Threshold</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Threshold_Yes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ThresholdNo_Monitor</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Signal_Split" name="Reorder signal method">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Threshold_Yes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Signal_Auto</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Signal_Manual</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_AutomatedAlert" name="Generate automated reorder alert">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Signal_Auto</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Auto_SignalMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_ManualCheck" name="Perform manual stock check">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Signal_Manual</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Manual_SignalMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Signal_Merge" name="Reorder needed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Auto_SignalMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Manual_SignalMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Merge_PlaceOrder</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PlaceOrder" name="Place order with supplier considering cost, delivery time and reliability">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Merge_PlaceOrder</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PlaceOrder_UpdateDelivery</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_UpdateExpectedDelivery" name="Update inventory system with expected delivery dates">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PlaceOrder_UpdateDelivery</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_UpdateDelivery_Wait</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_StockReceived" name="Stock received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_UpdateDelivery_Wait</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Wait_Inspect</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_QualityInspection" name="Inspect stock quality">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Wait_Inspect</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Inspect_Record</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_RecordStock" name="Record stock in system">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Inspect_Record</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Record_Store</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_StoreStock" name="Place stock on shelves or in storage">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Record_Store</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Store_UpdateLevels</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_UpdateLevels" name="Update inventory levels after restock">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Store_UpdateLevels</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_UpdateLevels_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_RestockComplete" name="Restock complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_UpdateLevels_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Monitor" sourceRef="StartEvent_Begin" targetRef="Task_MonitorStock" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Monitor_Threshold" sourceRef="Task_MonitorStock" targetRef="Gateway_Threshold_Split" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Threshold_Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Threshold_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Signal_Split" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ThresholdNo_Monitor" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Threshold_Split" targetRef="Task_MonitorStock" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Signal_Auto" name="Automated alert" sourceRef="Gateway_Signal_Split" targetRef="Task_AutomatedAlert" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Signal_Manual" name="Manual check" sourceRef="Gateway_Signal_Split" targetRef="Task_ManualCheck" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Auto_SignalMerge" sourceRef="Task_AutomatedAlert" targetRef="Gateway_Signal_Merge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Manual_SignalMerge" sourceRef="Task_ManualCheck" targetRef="Gateway_Signal_Merge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_PlaceOrder" sourceRef="Gateway_Signal_Merge" targetRef="Task_PlaceOrder" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PlaceOrder_UpdateDelivery" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrder" targetRef="Task_UpdateExpectedDelivery" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdateDelivery_Wait" sourceRef="Task_UpdateExpectedDelivery" targetRef="Event_StockReceived" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Wait_Inspect" sourceRef="Event_StockReceived" targetRef="Task_QualityInspection" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inspect_Record" sourceRef="Task_QualityInspection" targetRef="Task_RecordStock" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Record_Store" sourceRef="Task_RecordStock" targetRef="Task_StoreStock" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Store_UpdateLevels" sourceRef="Task_StoreStock" targetRef="Task_UpdateLevels" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdateLevels_End" sourceRef="Task_UpdateLevels" targetRef="EndEvent_RestockComplete" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
